args.title: Accept quoted column names in CSV header
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Modify parseStatement to use splitFields() for the header line instead of a simple split on commas. This will allow quoted column names with commas or quotes to be correctly parsed and avoid rejecting statements with quoted headers, fixing the "Malformed row" error when header fields have quotes.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The problem is in parseStatement where the header line is split by a simple comma instead of using splitFields. As a result, headers with quotes cause a columns count mismatch. The fix is to parse the header line with splitFields to correctly handle quoted column names.
